Message:
drm/amd/display: Fix writeback job lock evasion within dm_crtc_high_irq

[Why]
Coverity report LOCK_EVASION warning. Access
acrtc->wb_pending without lock wb_conn->job_lock.

[How]
Lock wb_conn->job_lock before accessing
acrtc->wb_pending.
